STANDARD.name: Whole Home Water Filtration and Softening System
STANDARD.whatItDoes: Softens and filters every drop of water entering your home. One high-capacity media tank handles hardness, chlorine, chloramine, taste and odor — so every faucet, shower and appliance gets treated water.
howItWorks: Granular catalytic coconut-shell carbon treats chlorine, chloramine and harmful contaminants first.
USA-made 10% crosslinked softening resin removes the calcium and magnesium that cause hard water.
Polishing gravel supports the media bed for even flow and maximum contact time.
The MSP ProValve automatically backwashes and regenerates the system — no effort from you.
leads: 48,000-grain softening capacity
28 GPM system flow — no pressure loss
Ceramic-disc ProValve with 72-hour memory backup
NSF-certified media, lifetime warranty

DUAL_CITY.name: Dual Tank Whole Home Water Filtration System
DUAL_CITY.whatItDoes: Gives carbon filtration and water softening their own dedicated high-capacity tanks. Each media bed works at full strength — ideal for larger households and heavy water use.
howItWorks: Tank one: granular activated catalytic coconut-shell carbon treats chlorine, chloramine, taste and odor.
Tank two: high-capacity 10% crosslinked resin removes hardness minerals.
Polishing gravel in both tanks keeps flow even and prevents channeling.
A single ProValve controls both tanks and backwashes them automatically.
leads: The only dual-tank system designed to self-clean the carbon tank
30 GPM valve flow for high-demand homes
Dedicated media beds last longer and filter deeper
NSF-certified media, lifetime warranty

SALT_FREE.name: Whole Home Complete Salt-Free Filtration System
SALT_FREE.whatItDoes: Whole-home carbon filtration plus salt-free scale conditioning — no salt bags, no brine discharge, no regeneration cycles. Keeps healthy minerals in your water while stopping them from sticking to pipes and appliances.
howItWorks: Granular activated coconut-shell carbon removes chlorine, chemicals and odors from all your water.
The salt-free conditioning tank transforms hardness minerals so they can no longer form scale.
Polishing gravel supports even water distribution through the media.
Zero electricity, zero drain line, zero salt — the simplest system to own.
leads: No salt, no brine discharge — eco-friendly by design
Keeps beneficial calcium and magnesium in your water
Protects water heaters, dishwashers and plumbing from scale
Lowest maintenance system in our lineup

DUAL_WELL.name: Dual Tank Well Water Whole Home Filtration System
DUAL_WELL.whatItDoes: Treats the three biggest well-water problems — iron, sulfur odor and hardness — chemical-free. Air-oxidation technology plus Katalox Light media handle staining and rotten-egg smell while a dedicated resin tank softens your water.
howItWorks: The MSP AIO ProValve creates a pressurized air pocket that naturally oxidizes iron, sulfur and manganese — no chemicals added.
Katalox Light media traps the oxidized particles and boosts pH for better-tasting water.
A dedicated resin tank removes calcium and magnesium hardness.
Both tanks self-clean with automatic backwashing.
leads: Chemical-free iron, sulfur and manganese treatment
Self-cleaning Katalox Light media — low maintenance
30 GPM valve flow built for well pumps
NSF-certified media, lifetime warranty

H2O2.name: Iron and Sulfur Treatment System
H2O2.whatItDoes: Our most powerful well-water solution. Hydrogen peroxide oxidation destroys even severe iron and sulfur problems at the point of entry, then dedicated carbon filtration and softening tanks finish the job.
howItWorks: The injection panel doses hydrogen peroxide the moment water enters your home, instantly breaking down iron and sulfur.
The oxidized particles are captured by a dedicated catalytic carbon tank — the peroxide itself is consumed and filtered out, never reaching your faucets.
A dedicated resin tank removes hardness for fully softened water.
Automatic backwashing flushes captured contaminants down the drain.
leads: Handles the most severe iron and rotten-egg sulfur conditions
Stronger than air-oxidation — works where other systems fail
Consistent chemical feed with dedicated holding tank
Complete package: oxidation + filtration + softening

TANKLESS_RO.name: HW800 AlkaPro Tankless RO
TANKLESS_RO.priceNote: Included free with any whole-home system
TANKLESS_RO.whatItDoes: Purified, alkaline drinking water on demand — straight from a dedicated faucet at your sink. No storage tank, 70% less under-sink space, and water treated the moment you ask for it.
howItWorks: 7-stage high-precision filtration with an ultra-fine 0.0001-micron spiral-flow RO membrane.
Removes heavy metals, dissolved solids, chlorine, microplastics, PFAs and other everyday contaminants.
Built-in alkaline remineralization adds beneficial minerals back for great taste and balanced pH.
Auto RO flush keeps the membrane clean automatically — filters are DIY twist-and-swap.
leads: 800 GPD capacity — beats Culligan (757) and Pentair (396)
2:1 low drain ratio — up to 3× less water waste
NSF/372 certified, lead-free water path
DIY filter changes — no service calls needed

TANK_RO.name: Traditional Tank RO
TANK_RO.priceNote: Included free with any whole-home system
TANK_RO.whatItDoes: The proven multi-stage RO setup: purified water is produced continuously, stored in a pressurized steel tank, and delivered instantly the second you open the faucet.
howItWorks: Multi-stage filtration strips sediment, chlorine and dissolved contaminants before the RO membrane.
The RO membrane rejects 94–99% of total dissolved solids.
A food-grade butyl bladder inside the steel tank keeps purified water pressurized and fresh.
Water is stored ready-to-pour — instant flow for glasses, pots and coffee makers.
leads: 94–99% TDS rejection
Instant delivery from pressurized storage
Corrosion-resistant steel shell, heavy-duty base
Compact footprint fits under most kitchen sinks
